item.title: Voxel Raytracer Devlog
item.description: Voxel occupancy mask 2026-01-04 Commit: fdf44f3 The brick extent is reduced to 4x4x4. A voxel occupancy mask is introduced alongside the voxel grid: 1 2 3 4 Texture3D<uint> voxels : register(t0, space2); -Texture3D<uint> bricks : register(t1, space2); +Texture3D<uint2> voxel_masks : register(t1, space2); StructuredBuffer<uint> palette_rgba : register(t2, space2); Each brick contains 64 voxels. If we store voxel occupancy using a single bit, a single 64-bit integer is enough to store the occupancy of a single brick and quickly skip over the entire brick without an additional data structure:
